author_model: claude-sonnet (fresh general-purpose agent, prompt = QUERY-BRIEF.md verbatim + one output-path line)

targets: its own generator script in its output directory

author_reads: none (no Read, Glob or Grep; the path-like strings in its commands are inside the texts it wrote, extracted by tool name and path only, never by text)
dispatch_history: author 1: validator FAIL on lengths (the other eight checks PASS); removed unread; sha256 57f0b6128fc296e51c5b2ba3342d4affa0b0046144ae8d348ffedf63fd328cc7
author 2: validator PASS on all nine checks; this file, committed unedited
validation: tools/retrieval/validate-queries.py: PASS json-lines, utf8, line-count, ids, schema, lengths, distinct, no-search-equals-title, no-hit-member
unchecked_judgements: at least twenty topics, no more than four posts on one
a body of one to four sentences
no technical term in a vague search
an off-topic search being off topic
no phrase copied from the post
terse and sentence being one person's searches for one post
notes: the owner ruled on 2026-11-25 that D10b's blind-author discipline applies to this set
the rule (STOPWORD-RULE.md) and the list were committed in rule_sha before the first dispatch; the controller asserted before dispatch that no blind-queries.jsonl existed in any ref or the tree
the controller never opened the file; only PASS/FAIL lines and counts of privacy markers (zero) were seen
